sample_data_notice: For local development and non-authenticated demonstration, high-fidelity sample vector geometries and representative geo-tagged field observations have been generated adhering strictly to the official NRSC/OGD schema. When live connectivity to Bhuvan WMS is active, official layers are requested directly.
